title: 微任务资格差距：现成SLM何时足以支撑Agent框架？
summary: 该研究构建了4个Agent微任务基准，测试Qwen3 0.6-8B等现成SLM能否达到预设阈值。结果显示16种配置全部不合格，量化到4位精度也无法改善，差距主要随模型规模而非精度变化。建议将SLM置于满足阈值的基线之后，仅在基线失败处使用。
summary_en: This study builds a benchmark of 4 agent microtasks to test whether off-the-shelf SLMs (Qwen3 0.6-8B) meet practitioner-defined thresholds. All 16 configurations fail eligibility, and 4-bit quantization does not help; the gap tracks model size more than precision. It recommends placing SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold and using them only where the baseline fails.
